These Lou and Andy face masks are made for two friends who want to turn up as one of British comedy's best-loved double acts. One of you is the patient carer, the other is the one who always changes his mind, and the whole party will know exactly who you are the second you walk in.

Lou and Andy Face Masks – Couple Fancy Dress Pair

You get two masks in one order: Lou Todd and Andy Pipkin, the pair from the noughties sketch show Little Britain. We print each face in full colour from our own artwork. Ready to Wear masks come cut to shape with the eye holes already cut out, and the elastic and sticky tabs are supplied for you to attach. DIY masks are print only, so you cut them out yourselves, and the elastic and sticky tabs are supplied with these too.

Why you'll love it

  • A ready-made double act costume for two, with no wigs or make-up needed
  • Printed on thick 350gsm silk card that holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so a spilt pint or a garden party won't ruin it
  • Ready to Wear masks have pre-cut eye holes, so you can see where you're going
  • Great for stag do masks, hen nights and photo booth shots

Size & details

  • Contents: 2 masks (Lou and Andy)
  • Size: each mask is 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Packaging: posted flat in a board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Fancy bringing more of the gang? Our comedy character masks come as singles too, so you can add Vicky Pollard or Bubbles DeVere for a full noughties fancy dress line-up.
